name: xTool P2S
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension ZY013 (exts/P2S), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 600 x 305; the canvas is 610 x 305); module from defaultPower 55 and laserType CO2. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
